fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant found that the main gate near Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore had been damaged overnight, causing a loss of roughly Rs. 3,00,000. The matter was brought to Coimbatore North PS on 2025-01-05, while the incident was placed on 2025-01-02 at about 19:40. Inban Selvam approached Coimbatore North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000182. Dinesh Prakash (mobile 9000000068) was named as a possible person of interest. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property allegedly damaged following a local dispute.
fields.Keywords: property damage, vandalism, main street, photograph, evening, mobile number, suspect
